attempts.text:
This plan rescues all 11 people with no deferrals, at a total cost of 122 minutes of driving.

**Key constraints**
- Naukunda shelter is the only evacuation point. Gosaikunda school is on higher ground but isn't designated, so people can't be dropped there.
- Car1 carries four passengers at a time and starts at Naukunda.
- The fastest route between Naukunda and Gosaikunda is the direct road, at 28 minutes (via Kalika it takes 31).
- The fastest route between Naukunda and Myagang is the direct road, at 5 minutes.

**Trips**

| Trip | Route | People rescued | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Naukunda → Gosaikunda → Naukunda | 4 injured | 56 |
| 2 | Naukunda → Gosaikunda → Naukunda | 4 children | 56 |
| 3 | Naukunda → Myagang → Naukunda | 3 elderly | 10 |

**Why this is optimal**
- **Trips needed:** The 8 people at Gosaikunda need two full trips of at least 56 minutes each. The Myagang trip adds only 10 minutes, and combining Myagang with a Gosaikunda trip wouldn't help because both of those trips are already full.
- **Deferring costs more:** Deferring all 3 elderly people would save 10 minutes but cost 150 in penalties. Deferring a full Gosaikunda carload would save 56 minutes but cost at least 240.

I put the injured first because they are the most urgent. The order doesn't change the cost as long as the car finishes back at Naukunda.

<plan>
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-school
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 gosaikunda-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-school
load car1 child 4
drive car1 gosaikunda-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 child 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter myagang-care-home
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 myagang-care-home naukunda-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
</plan>

COST: 122
